facts.statement: A community Ninja Duel event was held on Server 1 on Thursday 17 February 2011 at 15:00 Pacific Time for the US and Latin America.
facts.quote: jueves 17 de febrero del 2011 1500 hrs. Tiempo Pacifico (EE.UU. y Latino America) Servidor 1

facts.statement: A second Ninja Duel session was held on Server 1 on Friday 18 February 2011 at 09:00 PST / 18:00 CET / 17:00 GMT for the UK and Europe.
facts.quote: Viernes 18 de febrero del 2011 0900hrs PST/1800hrs. CET/1700hrs. GMT (UK y Europa) Servidor 1

facts.statement: To take part, players had to be present on the scheduled day and time; once there, they requested duels and accepted duel requests from others. The event ended when duels finished, and was to be announced again for the next call.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Evento Comunitario: Duelo Ninja)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event post announcing a Ninja Duel on Server 1 in February 2011, with separate times for the Americas and Europe. Players had to be present at the scheduled time, then request and accept duels until the event ended. The post also says a non-ninja fighter or warrior-type player can become a ninja by passing a test with Tim in Villadelago.

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Duelo Ninja
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event announcement for a 'Duelo Ninja' (Ninja Duel) held on Server 1 on February 17, 2011 (US and Latin America) and February 18, 2011 (UK and Europe). Players attend at the scheduled time, request duels and accept incoming duel requests. The post also says a player who has fighter-type combat skills can become a ninja by talking to Tim in Villadelago and passing his test.
